_derivation: AUTHORITATIVE ADJACENCY IS DERIVED, NOT THIS FILE (ADR 0022). The produced_by/triggers lists below are a human-readable, frozen SEED SUBSET. At catalog load, derive_card_events(SEED_MAP) replaces every non-empty-seed side with the sorted descendant-closure of that side's SEED_MAP seeds (derive_card_events.py); only empty-seed sides (e.g. game-end's raw lists, kept [] as the terminal invariant) pass through from this file. So these lists may lag the derived view (e.g. land-enters lists its seeds but the derived view expands land-ramp's closure to the full ramp-child set; game-end shows [] but the derived view carries alternate-win-condition/alternate-loss-condition/lose-trigger from SEED_MAP; library-depleted shows its mill seeds but the derived view expands mill-opponent's closure to mill-any/ingest). The four R5d-promoted producer events (land-enters/creature-enters-battlefield/token-created/creature-copied) were resynced to their current SEED_MAP seed sets 2026-11-18 (owner-ratified producer promotions; the stale `ramp` ref is gone, replaced by the `land-ramp` seed). To see the real adjacency, read SEED_MAP in derive_card_events.py. Some refs match zero live cards in the lake (sac, clones, tokens, combat, counters, artifacts) but are RETAINED: sac/clones await a seed rename in a later wave; tokens/combat/counters/artifacts are carried as shorthand otags by the hermetic parity fixtures, so deleting them shifts the held engine/resolve parity SHAs and is NOT output-inert (the audit's §8 lake-only inert estimate does not account for the fixtures). Their removal is deferred to a fixture-aware re-baseline.

land-enters-battlefield.rule: CR 305: a land entering the battlefield (play/fetch/extra land drop)

creature-enters-battlefield.rule: CR 603.6: ETB triggered abilities; tokens/reanimation/flicker put creatures onto the battlefield. Uses `repeatable-creature-tokens` (not the `repeatable-token-generator` umbrella — its non-creature-token children make no creature ETB) (#74 R2 §3.4 coupled fix)

permanent-leaves-battlefield.rule: CR 603.6c: leaves-the-battlefield triggers; flicker/blink and bounce cause leaves events

permanent-dies.rule: CR 700.4: a creature/permanent going to the graveyard from the battlefield (dies). The removal producer is the SUBTRACTIVE synth attribute `dies-removal` (otag:removal minus removal-exile/-bounce/-tuck) — zone-changes to exile/hand/library are NOT deaths and dodge death triggers; the holistic `removal` otag stays in permanent-leaves-battlefield (#74 R2 §3.1). deathtouch grants (deathtouch-counter/gains-deathtouch/gives-deathtouch) also produce death here: deathtouch damage is lethal, so it KILLS what it fights (ADR 0025, collapsed deathtouch-combat)

permanent-sacrificed.rule: CR 701.17: sacrifice as a cost/effect; a sacrifice is also a death event

card-enters-graveyard.rule: CR 404: graveyard zone; mill/discard/death/sacrifice fill the graveyard

spell-cast.rule: CR 601 (casting a spell): the CAST-ONLY node (ADR 0025 resource split — A1). Producers are the real CR 601.1b cast-generators: impulse-cast (exile-and-you-may-cast) and free-cast-another (cast ANOTHER spell for free). Copies are NOT cast (CR 707.12), so copy-* producers LEFT this node (they moved to spell-copied + spell-on-stack). The triggers are the cast-only/cast-or-copy payoffs a CAST sees: storm (storm-count-matters), prowess (prowess-like, via cast-trigger), second-spell-matters, cast-trigger(+you/other/self), and magecraft (CR 702.157a counts a cast, and magecraft is a taxonomy child of cast-trigger — a cast legitimately triggers it). The copy path to magecraft lives on spell-on-stack, so a COPY engine reaches magecraft there, NOT here.

spell-copied.rule: CR 707.10 / 707.12 (copying a spell): a COPY of a spell is put onto the stack and is NOT cast. The copy-production node (ADR 0025 resource split — A1). Producers are the copy-* families (copy-instant/copy-sorcery/copy-spell closure: copy-permanent-spell + gives-casualty/conspire/replicate/storm). triggers are empty — there is no clean copy-ONLY payoff otag; the cast-or-copy payoff (magecraft) fires on either and lives on the union node spell-on-stack, where a copy engine reaches it. A copy effect therefore lands in spell-copied + spell-on-stack, never in spell-cast (copies are not casts, so they must not reach storm/prowess).

spell-on-stack.rule: The UNION node (cast ∪ copied): a spell OR a copy is on the stack (ADR 0025 resource split — A1). Producers = the union of spell-cast's cast-generators and spell-copied's copy-producers (impulse-cast/free-cast-another ∪ copy-*). triggers = magecraft (CR 702.157a: 'whenever you cast OR copy an instant or sorcery'), the one payoff that fires on EITHER a cast or a copy. This is the magecraft home: a cast reaches magecraft here AND via spell-cast's cast-trigger closure; a COPY reaches magecraft ONLY here (copies never touch spell-cast), which is the point of the split — a copy engine lands on spell-on-stack + spell-copied and sees magecraft without over-promising storm/prowess.

creature-attacks.rule: CR 508: declare attackers; attack-trigger payoffs and go-wide

combat-damage-dealt.rule: CR 510: combat damage; double-strike/evasion/deathtouch are static combat-damage modifiers — their grants produce this event (deathtouch is lethal damage; ADR 0025, collapsed deathtouch-combat)

life-loss-drain.rule: CR 119.3 (life loss) / CR 120.3 (only damage to a PLAYER causes life loss): drain and symmetric life-loss payoffs (aristocrats). Producers are the player-facing damage/drain slice ONLY — burn to creatures/battles/planeswalkers (removal-burn, burn-battle, bombard, burn-creature) is NOT life loss and the `burn` umbrella was dropped (#74 R2 §3.2)

counter-placed.rule: CR 122: counters; +1/+1 and other counters placed on permanents

proliferate.rule: CR 701.27: proliferate adds another of each kind of counter

token-created.rule: CR 111 / 701.6: creating token permanents (creatures, Treasure, Food, Clue)

artifact-enters.rule: CR 603.6 / CR 603.6a: artifact ETB on a zone change (a permanent ENTERING); Treasure/Clue/Food and artifact tokens. A permanent that merely BECOMES an artifact (artifactify) or is animated into a creature (animate-artifact) does NOT re-enter, so fires no ETB — both dropped (#74 R2 §3.4)

food-created.rule: CR 701.6: Food token creation and consumption (eat Food to gain life); Food is defined at CR 111.10

recursion-from-graveyard.rule: CR 404 + reanimation/regrowth: a card RETURNS from the graveyard (the regrowth/reanimate act). Reading B (audit §3.6, #19): the PRODUCERS are the cards that DO the returning — the `recursion` root (covers every reanimate-*/recursion-* variant + regrowth/restock) — and the CONSUMERS (triggers) are the payoffs that care about something leaving the graveyard / acting from it (leaving-graveyard-matters, trigger-from-graveyard). The graveyard-FILLERS (discard/mill/sacrifice) are NOT producers here — they own `card-enters-graveyard.produced_by`, where the filler→reanimate graveyard engine lives; the opponent-scoped `discard` otag is dropped (§3.3)

extra-turn.rule: CR 500.7 / CR 720 (Taking an Extra Turn): an extra turn is created and taken after this one; infinite turns = effective win (policy). Split from the former monarch-or-extra-turn (#74 §2).

monarch.rule: CR 726 (The Monarch): a player becomes the monarch (draw at end step; designation moves on combat damage / monarch leaving). #74 §2.2 option ii (FUNCTIONAL SPLIT): Scryfall carries one monarch-matters tag on both makers and payoffs, so a single attr on both sides formed no edge (the p != c_ self-pair exclusion). The monarch-maker synth attr now isolates the PRODUCER side, so maker -> payoff edges form. Batch B B1: the maker-only pattern is oracle:'you become the monarch' OR the opponent/target-maker regex (target/that/an-/another player becomes the monarch) = 65 clean makers — it drops the Fioran-Reformist anti-monarch FP and adds the 4 target-maker cards; 0 pure whenever-payoff FPs.

creature-copied.rule: CR 707 / 701.6: a token or permanent that is a COPY of a creature is minted under your control (clone, steal-via-copy of a dying creature, populate-of-a-creature-token). Producers are the copy-creature/clone identity (the `clones` bucket) plus the token-copy families (copy-token/copy-self = populate); the EVENT covers token-copy even though the clones ARCHETYPE does not. A minted copy is a new creature/token permanent, so it is consumed by the creature-/token-enters payoffs (and, when the copy is also a Food as with Shelob, by the Food/lifegain payoffs).

untap.rule: CR 701.21: untap a permanent. Untap effects re-arm tapped abilities and attackers (the madness/activated-ability reuse loop, e.g. Anje untapping herself). Producers are the untapper families; consumers are the untapped-matters payoffs. NOTE: the Anje-style reuse loop closes through the card's own ACTIVATED ABILITY, a relation the otag catalog does not express as an untap consumer, so the untap edge isolates only on decks carrying an explicit untapped-matters payoff.

energy.rule: CR 122.1a: energy counters are PLAYER counters. One of the three resource events split out of the former generic `player-counter` (ADR 0025 resource-split doctrine — A2: distinct resources = distinct events). Producer = `energy-generator` (137, mechanic-exclusive prec 1.0) + proliferate (pseudo-proliferate/repeatable-proliferate — proliferate adds to ANY counter a player has, so it is a SHARED producer of energy/rad/experience). Consumer = `counter-fuel-energy` (122). This lights up the energy-generator -> counter-fuel-energy engine with no foreign-resource dilution (energy no longer shares a node with rad/experience).

rad.rule: Fallout rad counters (a PLAYER counter): on your upkeep you mill that many and lose life per nonland milled, then remove one. One of the three resource events split out of the former generic `player-counter` (ADR 0025 resource-split doctrine — A2). Rad counters have NO Scryfall otag, so the producer is the oracle-text synth attr `rad-counter` + proliferate (shared producer). Consumers are the rad payoffs: rad fuels self-mill (mill-* / synergy-mill — the rad->mill engine) and feeds proliferate (pseudo-proliferate/repeatable-proliferate/synergy-proliferate). The rad self-mill is modeled as a self-deplete route in combo_win.fid_route (card-enters-graveyard / self-deplete).

experience.rule: Experience counters (a PLAYER counter, C15+ e.g. Ezuri/Mizzix/Meren and later Avatar/God-of-War commanders): they accumulate on a player and the card's own ability scales with the count. One of the three resource events split out of the former generic `player-counter` (ADR 0025 resource-split doctrine — A2). No Scryfall otag exists, so the producer is the NEW oracle-text synth attr `experience-counter` (oracle:'experience counter', 19 members — 16 legendary-creature commanders incl. all 5 original C15, + the Experience/Spirit tokens and The Goblin Sparring Grounds land; 0 false positives) + proliferate (shared producer). triggers is empty: the experience PAYOFF is the producing card's OWN scaling ability (Ezuri's +1/+1 on attack, Mizzix's cost reduction), which is not a separate otag-expressible consumer (same posture as untap's self-ability caveat). The experience fids still route to this event in the combo walk.

mana-produced.rule: CR 106: producing mana (tapping lands, mana dorks, rituals, Treasure sacrifice). Covers 179 Spellbook mana fids (13.3% of features, 34% of corpus combos had no event home before this). Classified by feature name, not by the uncountable+mana derivation (see ADR 0007 when wired).

game-end.rule: CR 104.1/104.2/104.3: the game ends. Terminal node — the walk target. Fids map here with polarity (win/draw/loss) from the research route and scope from the feature. Rule-edges from life-loss-drain (SBA 104.3b), library-depleted (CR 104.3c), and combat-damage-dealt reach game-end through the EventEffect graph. Producers (SEED_MAP, derived): alternate-win-condition (win) + alternate-loss-condition (loss) — Batch B B4. Polarity is DERIVED PER-PRODUCER-OTAG / per-card (combo_win.fid_route reads the fid's own win-vs-loss text), NOT from the node's multi-polarity field, so a Lich/Last-Chance reads loss and an Approach reads win; the produced_by list adds graph structure only and never maps an otag to a win attribution. The raw lists below stay [] (terminal invariant); the derived view carries the producers/consumers.

library-depleted.rule: CR 104.3c: a player with an empty library who would draw loses. Covers mill/library-exile fids directed at opponents. Batch B B5: the deckout mechanic was an empty terminal node; now populated. produced_by = the opponent-depleting mill seeds mill-opponent (476) / mill-each (61) / mill-exile (160) — mill-self is NOT a producer (self-deplete is the fid/alt-win path and is not reached by these seeds' closures). triggers = the deckout consumers empty-library (9, the Lab-Man/Thassa's-Oracle win-flip) + library-size-matters (23). The CR-104.3c rule-edge to game-end lives in combo_win.py (library-depleted is a _RULE_TERMINAL_EVENT; fid_route routes opponent depletion to deckout-opp, self to self-deplete).

poisoned.rule: CR 104.3d / 704.5c: a player with ten or more poison counters loses the game (SBA). Poison counters are PLAYER counters; producers are the 6-giver union of mechanic-exclusive poison GIVER otags (gains-poisonous, gives-infect, gives-poisonous, gives-toxic, poison-opponents, poisonous; all prec 1.0 vs the poison family) — Batch B B3 aligned SEED_MAP (was 5) with this file (was already 6); gains-poisonous's 2 members (Hish, Virulent Sliver) already carried gives-poisonous so the card-level set is unchanged. The parent poison-mechanics (198) is still excluded because its closure also carries the consumer synergy-poison and the removes-infect cards (producer-role impurity). The payoff/consumer is synergy-poison (42). The poisoned -> game-end WIN rule-edge lives in combo_win.py (EVENT_EDGE_CLASSES['poisoned'] = ['altwin::poisoned']); it is walk-inert until a poison fid route exists (fid 1800 -> None today).

domain.rule: CR 104.2a: an effect states that a player wins the game (Coalition Victory: control a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color -> you win). The reusable board-state is a STATE-EVENT `domain` (ADR 0024): enablers PRODUCE the five-color/all-basic-type state, the wincon CONSUMES it. produced_by = the authored SYNTH attr `color-fixing` (Batch B B2: union oracle:'mana of any color' OR otag:rainbow-land OR otag:nonbasic-basic-land-type OR oracle:'every basic land type' OR otag:tutor-land-basic OR otag:fetchland, 1284 fixers; no clean otag exists and the evaluator must not grow a produced_mana atom, ADR 0009 — the former KNOWN GAP of basic-land-TYPE fixers is now closed, incl. the 0-FP all-basic-type converter oracle 'every basic land type' = Prismatic Omen/Dryad/Leyline-of-the-Guildpact/Nylea's-Presence/Overlord-of-the-Hauntwoods; color-fixing stays EDGE-LESS so broadening cannot create a domain archetype FP). triggers = the authored SYNTH attr `five-color-win` (otag:alternate-win-condition AND oracle:'each color' = Coalition Victory + Call the Spirit Dragons). The domain -> game-end WIN rule-edge lives in combo_win.py (EVENT_EDGE_CLASSES['domain'] = ['altwin::domain']); walk-inert until a domain fid route exists (none today, mirrors poisoned). life-threshold was DROPPED this wave — the existing `lifegain` event already models the lifegain-win (altwin::lifegain = Felidar/Angel/Test); a second event would double-count.
